description.value: Third Beach Concession is the food service kiosk serving Third Beach in Stanley Park, one of Vancouver's most scenic and popular waterfront destinations. It sits along the Seawall route, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists touring the park. The concession offers beach-goers and passing cyclists a convenient place to grab food without leaving the park.
